description: The Franka Emika Panda on the M3 spatial multibond mechanics with the Gaz et al. 2019 physically feasible dynamics. panda-free: the frictionless arm released at rest from the ready pose, against MuJoCo's forward dynamics of the same parameters. panda: the Robot subsystem (mechanics, bond-graph joint drives with gear, rotor inertia, elastic gear, Gaz friction and torque limits, quantized encoders, joint-torque sensors) under a 1 kHz outer layer of Cartesian quintic trajectory, He & Liu analytical IK and PD with gravity and friction feedforward; checks against MuJoCo gravity, the design forward kinematics and the Python IK. Generated by design/build_expected.py.
